findings.finding: Condition 3-prime says the naturals are the smallest successor-closed set but omits that the set must contain 0; otherwise the empty set is the smallest such set.
findings.controlling_evidence: The condition being reformulated says every number is obtained from 0, and the ensuing closure construction is explicitly the least closed set containing o.
findings.required_translation_handling: Add the containing-0 requirement and an adjacent OLTEINF-001 note.

findings.finding: The definition quantifies over any function, while the lemma suddenly says o in A without binding A. The proof's witness ran(f) union {o} is closed only under the intended self-map typing.
findings.controlling_evidence: The later Dedekind-algebra definition explicitly has f:A→A and o∈A; under that type, ran(f)∪{o} is a closed subset of A.
findings.required_translation_handling: Bind f:A→A and o∈A, restrict closure candidates to subsets of A, and add an adjacent OLTEINF-002 note.

findings.finding: The theorem permits any set X, but the proof invokes minimality directly on X even when X is not a subset of the self-map domain N.
findings.controlling_evidence: The theorem's own induction condition makes N∩X contain o and be s-closed; the typed closure lemma applies to that subset and yields N⊆N∩X⊆X.
findings.required_translation_handling: Use N∩X explicitly in the proof and add an adjacent OLTEINF-003 note.

findings.finding: The set-closure definition is stated for an arbitrary function and set without an ambient domain/codomain in which every f(x) is defined.
findings.controlling_evidence: Its use in the helper has a self-map of C (the displayed codomain A is contained in C) and base C minus B; the least closure is taken among subsets of C.
findings.required_translation_handling: Bind an ambient U, f:U→U, B⊆U and X⊆U; add an adjacent OLTEINF-004 note.

findings.finding: The helper conclusion nests cardeq(A,B) as an argument of another cardeq expression.
findings.controlling_evidence: The assumptions A⊆B⊆C and A≈C are the cardinal sandwich hypothesis; the proof constructs a bijection C→B and therefore proves B≈C.
findings.required_translation_handling: Replace the malformed conclusion with cardeq(B,C) and add an adjacent OLTEINF-005 note.

findings.finding: The proof announces ran(g)=B, then fixes x in B and proves only that every such x is hit.
findings.controlling_evidence: If y∈F then g(y)=f(y)∈A⊆B; if y∉F then y∉C\B because C\B⊆F, so g(y)=y∈B. This supplies the omitted ran(g)⊆B direction.
findings.required_translation_handling: Insert that missing inclusion argument before the existing B⊆ran(g) argument and add an adjacent OLTEINF-006 note.
